verdicts.explanation: The paper reports 1.91 mS/cm at 25℃ for Mg0.25 NZSP sintered at 1200/1100℃-12h, with Ea = 0.200 eV for that same processing condition. The 1100℃ hold and 12 h time match, and relative density is correctly null because the paper gives 96.4% only for Mg0 NZSP.

The paper gives 0.62 mS/cm for the undoped Mg0 NZSP sample in the Section 2.3 conductivity discussion, and 96.4% relative density for Mg0 at 1200/1100℃-12h. Activation energy is correctly null because the text gives no Mg0 value; the Fig. 3e labels are too garbled to assign one reliably.
